requirements.text: At least 1 year of sales experience
Comfortable navigating digital tools such as Slack, CRM software and Google Sheets
Works autonomously as a self-starter who can work independently and efficiently
Outgoing with outstanding rapport-building and active listening skills
Patient and professional with clients, showing empathy especially under pressure when discussing finances
Financially motivated individual who can meet and exceed sales targets
Implements feedback from sales coaches as a team player
Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills
Home office or quiet place to work
Desktop or laptop with more than 8GB of RAM, since devices with 8GB or less have issues supporting the system
Available for the 10 AM to 6 PM EST training schedule and Monday to Friday shifts

resumes.text:
Jordan Reyes
Remote Inside Sales Professional
Phone: 555-0142 | jordan.reyes@example.com

Summary
Results-driven sales professional with three years of inside sales experience in consumer lending and insurance. Known for warm, honest conversations that turn inbound calls into enrolled customers. I thrive in a remote setup where I can focus, and I take coaching seriously.

Experience
Inside Sales Representative, Brightline Lending Group (Remote), March 2022 to Present
- Handled 45 to 60 inbound calls per day, qualifying leads and presenting loan options to customers.
- Exceeded quarterly quota by 118 percent in the most recent quarter and earned the team top performer award.
- Ran my own call schedule and pipeline without daily check-ins from management, keeping follow-ups on time every week.
- Kept the team updated through our daily chat channel, logged every call outcome in our client database, and tracked pipeline numbers in a shared workbook.
- Helped callers who felt embarrassed about money stay on the line and open up, calming tense conversations so they could move forward.
- Took feedback from my sales coach during weekly one-on-ones and applied changes to my opening script within a week.

Sales Associate, Harbor Insurance Agency (Remote), June 2020 to February 2022
- Closed policy renewals and cross-sold coverage to existing clients.
- Maintained a 92 percent retention rate across a book of 300 accounts.

Education
Bachelor of Arts in Communication, Eastfield State University, 2020

Skills
- Strong rapport-building and active listening
- Outbound and inbound sales
- Remote work and time management
- Customer relationship tracking and reporting

Availability and Setup
I am available Monday through Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM EST, and I can attend the full mandatory first week of training. I work from a dedicated home office with a 500 Mbps fiber internet connection. My laptop has 8GB of RAM.
